Gateway.Title: Grand Design AI Gateway
Gateway.MenuHint: Choose the AI that reads session notes (local Ollama recommended), and tune how it writes Skills and Classes for your table.
Gateway.Cleared: Grand Design AI Gateway disabled -- the built-in local analyzer will read notes.

Jev.Help: Jev answers small yes/no and pick-one questions in under a second: it skips passages with no character action, works out who did each deed, double-checks outcomes and dark deeds, and ranks proposals. It never writes text or replaces your model, and if it fails, analysis carries on without it.
Jev.ApiKeyPlaceholder: from typesafe.ai (kept in this browser only)
Jev.Triage: Skip passages with no character action
Jev.Attribution: Work out who did each deed
Jev.TestHint: Checks the key and endpoint and lists Jev's models.
Jev.ErrorCors: Your browser blocked the call to Jev (CORS or network). Set the Jev endpoint to a proxy that adds CORS headers in front of https://api.typesafe.ai, then test again.
Jev.ErrorAuth: Jev rejected the API key (401/403). Check the key in your TypeSafe account.
Jev.ErrorTimeout: Jev did not answer in time. Check the endpoint, or raise the Jev timeout under Advanced.
Jev.ErrorNoKey: Paste a Jev API key first.
Jev.ErrorMissingClient: This build of Grand Design has no Jev client yet (scripts/ai/jev.js).
Jev.SaveNoKey: Jev is switched on but has no API key (untick Use Jev, or paste the key from TypeSafe).
